Purple Dragon GIF Studio

A single-workspace GIF editor for video, images, captions, and animated effects.

Source ZIP · v0.6.1
Get the softwareRepositoryGet help

What it does

  • GIF search with 50 results per page
  • Fonts, captions, emojis, and moving flame effects
  • Optional encrypted GIPHY-key saving on Windows

Requirements

Windows with Python 3.11 or newer. Internet is needed for first-time dependency setup.

Getting started

Extract the full ZIP and run Start-GIF-Studio.bat. Review media and font licenses before sharing exports.

Release notes, integrity & license

Read the current project documentation before installing. Where a release supplies checksums or signed manifests, use the instructions for that exact package. Check the repository’s license and third-party notices before reusing code or assets.

Project information reviewed November 12, 2026. For new versions, follow the repository’s release notes.
